text: App is great - but there are some things to improve: for example database of exercises could be larger and UI is kinda outdated (I'll gladly give more extensive feedback and help with this one via email). One thing I truly love about this app is amazing battery consumption economy. Seriously every other gym app use up to ~50% on 2hrs workout while this uses maybe up to 15-20%. This aspect is very important to me as I have 2yrs old phone with pretty trashed battery at this point.

text: Nice overall workout tracking app. Really love the layout of the exercises, sets and reps during a routine. The option to calculate weights that you need for the set is just outstanding. The database of exercises is practically unlimitted plus you can add your own exercises. One main downsite for me is the fact that Hevy doesn't support Android Watches (eg. Samsung Galaxy Watch4) as opposed to Apple Watches. I would like to see that option for Android added. Would be a 5 star app for me then.
